head: codex/695-runtime-agent-partial-checkpoint-s3
title: [v0.92.1][Runtime] Snapshot resident agents every five minutes and archive partials to S3
body:
Closes #695

Adds bounded five-minute partial checkpoints for every resident agent, including the Shepherd, with atomic local persistence, asynchronous S3 archival, deterministic per-agent latest pointers, and validated local or archived restoration. Cloud failure degrades archive freshness without blocking Runtime readiness.

Runtime roster/detail APIs and Observatory expose backing provider/model plus truthful snapshot and archive status. Terraform defines the private versioned KMS-encrypted archive, lifecycle retention, and separate least-privilege writer and restore permissions; no AWS apply is performed by this PR.

Focused proof covers 18 checkpoint tests, the ControlService multi-agent/multi-cycle/restart path, monotonic conversation restoration, 20 roster tests, 9 OpenAPI tests, Observatory rendering, Terraform validation and 11-add/0-change/0-destroy plan policy, formatting, acceptance AC-1 through AC-10, and independent exact-head review with no remaining findings.
